description: Expected results for pysteps' own official tests run on the official MeteoSwiss (mch) radar sample of 2015-05-15 from pySTEPS/pysteps-data (commit e95a6ef). inputs/ are the 40 unmodified official GIF files. Pass rules: (a) the 130 official pytest tests pass with their own assert values; (b) the 8 official STEPS skill settings (seed 42) give CRPS below the official limits in test_nowcasts_steps.py and equal to the values recorded on this server. Two clean runs gave identical CRPS values (deterministic with seed 42).
